description: Binary assertion tests for /loss-risk-gate skill output quality — economic safety review detecting avoidable loss, silent profit blocks, fail-open behavior, proof gaps, and observability gaps

tests.name: safe_refactor_produces_go_verdict
tests.description: Rename internal variable and function in risk_state_gate.rs with matching callsite update. No behavior change, no safety semantics change. Skill should produce GO verdict with PASS trading lens.
tests.prompt: Run /loss-risk-gate on this diff. The diff renames a function and local variable in risk_state_gate.rs and updates the callsite in engine.rs — no logic change.

assertions.check: Output contains a verdict of GO (not NO-GO)
Output contains Trading Lens of PASS (not BLOCKING or HARDENING)
Output contains zero BLOCKING findings
Output contains the Pre-gate confirmation section (§F of skill output)
Output is under 600 words total (clean GO should be concise)

tests.name: fail_open_dispatch_flagged
tests.description: PolicyGuard::resolve_trading_mode replaced with cached_mode.unwrap_or(TradingMode::Active) — classic fail-open that allows unrestricted trading when policy cache is cold. Must produce NO-GO with LOSS_RISK_BLOCKING.
tests.prompt: Run /loss-risk-gate on this diff. The diff replaces PolicyGuard's fail-closed staleness checks with a cached mode lookup that defaults to TradingMode::Active when the cache is empty.

assertions.check: Output contains a verdict of NO-GO
Output contains Trading Lens of BLOCKING
Output contains at least one LOSS_RISK finding
Output mentions TradingMode::Active as the unsafe default
Output recommends a fix (smallest safe fix section or equivalent)

tests.name: silent_profit_block_flagged
tests.description: Intent classifier changed to treat ALL intents as Open, including valid Close/reduce-only intents. In ReduceOnly mode this silently blocks all profit-taking close orders. Must produce NO-GO with PROFIT_BLOCK_BLOCKING.
tests.prompt: Run /loss-risk-gate on this diff. The diff modifies classify_intent() to always return IntentClass::Open, which means ReduceOnly mode will reject valid Close orders that should be allowed for profit-taking and risk reduction.

assertions.check: Output contains a verdict of NO-GO
Output contains at least one PROFIT_BLOCK finding
Output mentions Close intent classification or reduce_only as the root cause
Output contains Trading Lens of BLOCKING
Output recommends a fix to restore Close intent classification

tests.name: missing_causal_proof_flagged
tests.description: New safety-critical VolatilityGate added to execution pipeline but with only a trivial unit test — no TRIP/NON-TRIP acceptance test proving causality via dispatch_count or reject_reason. Must flag missing proof as blocker.
tests.prompt: Run /loss-risk-gate on this diff. The diff adds a new VolatilityGate to the execution pipeline. The gate is safety-critical (incorrect dispatch during high-vol causes loss) but has only a trivial unit test — no TRIP/NON-TRIP acceptance test proving causality.

assertions.check: Output contains a verdict of NO-GO
Output contains Trading Lens of BLOCKING
Output mentions missing causal proof, TRIP test, or acceptance test
Output mentions TRIP test requirement specifically
Output contains the Safety-Critical Proof Table (§D of skill output)

tests.name: stale_state_risk_flagged
tests.description: Removes market data freshness checks from PreflightGate and switches pricer to use cached mid price without freshness validation. Trading on stale data can cause immediate loss. Must produce NO-GO with LOSS_RISK_BLOCKING.
tests.prompt: Run /loss-risk-gate on this diff. The diff removes L2 book staleness checks and price feed freshness checks from PreflightGate, and switches the pricer to use a cached mid price without freshness validation.

assertions.check: Output contains a verdict of NO-GO
Output contains at least one LOSS_RISK finding
Output mentions stale data, freshness, or cached market data as the risk
Output contains Trading Lens of BLOCKING
Output recommends a fix to restore freshness checks
